approaches.title: Weighted reverse-alphabet degree using a fold
approaches.summary: Iterate over the string's bytes and accumulate each character's reverse alphabet value multiplied by its one-based position. Revision 2 simplifies the reverse-degree calculation without changing the overall strategy.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Computes the weighted reverse alphabet degree with a byte iterator, positional weights, and a fold.
Simplifies the reverse alphabet value from an absolute-value expression to `b'z' - b + 1` while preserving the same fold-based algorithm.
